name: Broken glass
inspectText: The glass is thick but shattered cleanly. There's a tiny trace of oil on the edge.

name: Wet footprint
description: A muddy footprint near the vault.
inspectText: The footprint is large, size 12, with a distinct tread pattern. It's still wet.

name: Lockpick set
inspectText: High-quality lockpicks, slightly worn. One pick has a small notch.

name: Coffee cup
description: A half-empty coffee cup with lipstick stain.
inspectText: The cup is warm. The lipstick shade is a deep red, and there's a faint smell of almonds.

name: Visitor log
inspectText: Only Dr. Vega, Janitor Moore, and Visitor Chen signed in. The times show Chen arrived at 7pm, Moore at 6:30pm, Vega at 6pm. The theft was at 7:30pm.

name: Rope
description: A wet nylon rope tied to the roof hatch.
inspectText: The rope is strong and has a knot that looks like a sailor's knot. It's wet from the rain.

name: Cloth fragment
description: A torn piece of fabric caught on the hatch.
inspectText: Dark blue cotton, possibly from a uniform. It has a small stain that smells like chemicals.
